record.body:
## Rationale

`observation` (feedback, investigation-observation) is an occurrence: lifecycle `recorded` only, no supersede. Backlog status must move open → promoted | dismissed while keeping one active claim per subject. `current-status` (assessment, release, goals) supports supersede and a payload status enum, which matches the promote/dismiss interface already chosen.

## Counter-argument

Staying on observation would keep backlog next to feedback in the same family and avoid another current-claim type. The cost is no legal status transition, so promote/dismiss would require delete-or-correct hacks the contract does not offer.

payload.choice: project:backlog-item uses current-status with supersede for status
